/ -> /conf -> /copy -> /edit -> /fork -> /help -> /new -> /open
/c -> /conf -> /copy
/copy  -> /copy agents-file -> /copy config-dir -> /copy config-file
/copy l -> /copy last-message
/copy sn -> /copy snippets-dir
/edit  -> /edit agents-file -> /edit config-dir -> /edit config-file
/edit sn -> /edit snippets-dir
/open  -> /open agents-file -> /open config-dir -> /open config-file -> /open home-dir -> /open scratch-dir -> /open session-chat-file -> /open session-dir -> /open session-log-file -> /open skills-dir -> /open snippets-dir -> /open system-prompt-file -> /open workspace-dir
/open sn -> /open snippets-dir
// -> //add -> //ask -> //note
